The '''bubse tree''' was a<ref name="TEA" /> common<ref name="Mask">''[[Mask of the Pirate Queen]]''</ref> bulbous [[Tree/Legends|tree]] found on<ref name="TEA" /> the surface<ref name="Mask" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]].<ref name="TEA" /> The plant was well known for the miraculous medicinal properties of its [[Plant/Legends|roots]]. Saleucami's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Taleucema]], had the planet's only mass production of the tree, and the roots were the city's main export.<ref name="Mask" /> Bubse roots were bought in high [[Currency/Legends|prices]] by aesthetes of the [[Zealots of Psusan/Legends|Zealots of Psusan]],<ref name="TEA" /> a [[Gender/Legends|female]]-empowering<ref name="Far Horizons">''[[Far Horizons]]''</ref> religious<ref name="CSWEZealots">{{CSWECite|III|369|Zealots of Psusan}}</ref> cult.<ref name="TEA" /> The root was also used illicitly in the concentrated anesthetic [[bubse spice]], which had the ability to make individuals to become numb physically and mentally.<ref name="Mask" />

Saleucami's [[Paradise (Saleucami)|Paradise]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] had doors crafted from the wood of bubse trees. At some point during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Mask" /> which formed in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}}, which includes the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the aging former [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Graf Lind]] often carried a polished bubse wood cane, as his inexpensive prosthetic [[Limb/Legends|leg]] made him walk with a limp.<ref name="Mask" />

==Behind the scenes==
The bubse tree was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TEA" />
